items.exampleEn: I buy food at the supermarket.
There is a big bookstore near the station.
items.exampleZh: 車站附近有一家大書店。

items.exampleEn: I spend a lot of money on books.
I want to buy a new bag.

items.sentenceEn: How much money do you have?

items.audioEn: This book is ten dollars. Can I pay by card?
items.audioZh: 這本書十美元，我可以刷卡嗎？

items.sentenceEn: I spend too much money on clothes.
They sell fruit at the supermarket.

items.stemEn: Here is ten dollars. Please keep the ____.
items.stemZh: 這是十美元，零錢不用找了。

items.passageEn: On Saturday, Amy goes shopping. First, she goes to the supermarket and buys some fruit and milk. Then she goes to a bookstore and buys two books. She pays with twenty dollars and gets two dollars in change. Amy spends a lot of money every Saturday.
items.passageZh: 星期六，Amy 去購物。她先去超市買了一些水果和牛奶，然後到書店買了兩本書。她付了二十美元，找回兩美元。Amy 每個星期六都花很多錢。

referenceEn: I want to buy this book.
I'd like to buy this book.
rubricZh: 「想買」可用 want to buy、would like to buy 等

items.promptZh: 我每天花一個小時走路上班。
referenceEn: I spend an hour walking to work every day.
Every day, I spend one hour walking to work.
rubricZh: spend＋時間＋動名詞（例如 spend an hour walking）；寫 It takes me an hour to walk to work 也正確
「一個小時」可寫，例如 an hour、one hour 等
